title: Empirical Phase-3 live validation: restart API + run 30+ picker advances + mine post-cutover cost / parse-fail / retry / capture-usage data
goal: Three back-to-back tasks (#330 structured outputs, #332 memory truncation, #333 review checkpoint) each DEFERRED live validation to the operator with phrases like 'will surface in next operator run' and 'requires API restart'. The result: the $300/day → ≤$100/day cost-reduction target is plausible from math but unverified, the structured-outputs zero-parse-fail claim is unverified live, and the rotation saving from backlog-392 (once wired) is also unverified. This task is the explicit agent-runnable validation step: restart the API server with current code, run the assessment loop against any reachable target for ≥30 advances, then run `scripts/_phase3_checkpoint_mine.py` on the post-cutover log and append results to the Phase-3 checkpoint report. Also: #334 RECENT_CAPTURES capture-usage validation — mine logs for evidence that the picker actually references captured values in its reasoning text (verifies #393's effectiveness).
scope: Pure validation task — no code changes. Agent restarts the API server (systemd if available, otherwise direct uvicorn), triggers a 30+-advance run against juice-shop or testfire (which are reachable per #329 checkpoint), waits for completion or natural stop, runs the existing `scripts/_phase3_checkpoint_mine.py` on `/tmp/aegispt-api.log`, captures the post-cutover matrix (cost/hop, cache_read_input_tokens, parse-fail count, retry-exhausted count, picker-recovered count, RECENT_CAPTURES references in reasoning text), and writes a section 10 addendum to `docs/checkpoints/2026-mythos-phase3-review.md` with before/after numbers + go/no-go on the ≤$100/day claim. If the data refutes the claim, file a follow-up tuning task instead of declaring success.
generation_reason: Identified during the 10-task deferred-capability audit. #330 said 'Live test on Gruyere produces zero JSON parse failures across 20+ picker advances → DEFERRED to operator validation'. #332 said 'Logged cache_read_input_tokens per picker hop drops measurably after deployment → DEFERRED'. #333 said 'empirical post-Phase-3 cost/parse-fail measurement requires operator to restart the API server with current code + run loop against any target for 30+ advances'. All three are AGENT-RUNNABLE per [[feedback_self_validation]] memory. This task makes the validation explicit and assigns it to the agent.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Validation + report append only. Do NOT modify api/app/services/, do NOT modify workers/, do NOT tune the picker (tuning belongs in a separate follow-up if data refutes the claim).
constraints.prerequisite_dependencies: backlog-392 (rotate wiring) should be merged first so post-cutover data reflects the FULL Phase-3 saving stack. If 392 is not yet merged, note that and run against current-tip code anyway.
constraints.honest_reporting: If post-cutover cost is higher than projected, write that result. Do NOT cherry-pick a metric to validate the claim. Per [[feedback_constraint_recap_noise]] — load-bearing failures get documented load-bearing; near-misses are flagged for tuning.

success_criteria: API server restarted with current code (verifiable via `git rev-parse HEAD` matching the deployed worker's import-time log).
Run produces ≥30 picker advances on a real target (juice-shop or testfire — both reachable per #329).

scripts/_phase3_checkpoint_mine.py output appended to docs/checkpoints/2026-mythos-phase3-review.md as section 10 with: total advances, avg input/cache_read/cache_creation/output tokens per hop, total cost, parse-fail count, picker_retry_exhausted count, picker_recovered count, RECENT_CAPTURES citation count in reasoning text.
Section 10 closes with explicit go/no-go on the ≤$100/day claim — if no-go, files a separate follow-up tuning task in this same commit.
Honest result: if data refutes a #330/#332/#334 claim, that's the finding; do not paper over.

acceptance_criteria: go/no-go decision recorded with explicit numbers.
If no-go, follow-up tuning task filed in the same commit.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
Ideally backlog-392 (rotate wiring) merged first; if not, document the gap in section 10.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with the live numbers.
Promote the next queued item into NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Tuning the picker (separate task if needed).
Re-measuring on every target stack (one reachable target suffices for the cost claim).
Live Gruyere validation (different gap, separate from cost validation).
